title: Currents given by L¹ densities on unit faces: integrability of the integrands, existence (linearity and sequential continuity), and the mass bound M ≤ Σ∫|w_F| (Simon Ch. 6, (29), (34); step 6 of the parent proof)
statement: Conventions (as in the selected node): ℝ^P = Euclid P, ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hᵈ = μHE[d], e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^P, x_i the i-th coordinate. n := m + 1. For a pair p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P): Φ_p(y) := z + Σ_{j<n} y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ ℝⁿ (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)); e_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}); Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} with Lebesgue measure (volume); F_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for i ∈ range ι, x_i = z_i for i ∉ range ι} (the closed unit face of the selected node's statement); A_p := Φ_p(Q₁) (the open face). 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d (domain univ throughout); ∂X = X.boundary; M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass (Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm); IMRep and IsIntegerMultiplicity are the contract notions. Statement: let P, m ∈ ℕ, s a finite set of pairs p = (z, ι) with every ι strictly increasing, and w_p : ℝⁿ → ℝ (p a pair) with w_p integrable on Q₁ for every p ∈ s. Then (I) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) and p ∈ s, y ↦ w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) is integrable on Q₁; (II) there is D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with D(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P); (III) every D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) satisfying this formula has M(D) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (w : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (w p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), ∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (fun y => w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ (∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) → D.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |w p y|)
